drums.tags: Industrial techno with heavy EBM influences. A distorted, overdriven kick drum provides a constant four-on-the-floor pulse at 130 BPM in the key of F minor. A resonant, metallic synth sequence runs in sixteenth notes, modulated by a low-pass filter sweep. A gritty, monophonic saw-wave bassline syncopates against the kick. Percussion includes sharp, compressed open hi-hats on the off-beats and a layered snare with a short gated reverb on beats two and 4. Occasional industrial foley samples, resembling clanging metal and steam hisses, are processed with heavy delay and bit-crushing. The arrangement features sudden low-frequency oscillations and white noise risers that peak before rhythmic drops.

bass.tags: Industrial techno with heavy distortion and experimental sound design. A distorted, overdriven kick drum provides a rhythmic pulse at 135 BPM in 4/4 time. A resonant, metallic synth sequence with high-pass filtering and automated resonance sweeps creates a shifting harmonic texture. Gritty, bit-crushed percussion loops and white noise bursts are layered with mechanical foley sounds. A deep, saturated sub-bass follows the kick pattern. The track features aggressive sidechain compression and industrial soundscapes with metallic clangs and digital glitches.
